d:
Hello everyone,
This is the my first upload on this site. I've recently imported quite a few doujinshi and artbooks, and I've noticed that a few of them can't be found online, so I've decided to try my best to give back to this website by scanning them. I'm a total newbie at this, and I'm not totally sure that I do a good job scanning, but I'm gonna my best for the sake of my fellow Kasenfags. Please be nice. (´∇`)

Artist: Azuma Aya (aka Azmaya)
Support her by buying her works and following her online!
Website: https://www.azmaya.net/
Pixiv: https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/9853
Booth: https://azmaya.booth.pm/
Melonbooks: https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/circle/index.php?circle_id=1337

PS: I also have a copy of HANAOUGI by the same artist and some other Kasen doujinshi that I want to try scanning soon, but I'm nervous about whether I can safely take apart books bound with glue. If any experts have good advice then please let me know.
